visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article/resource teaser grid: image, category eyebrow and linked title, with optional summary and button

contentPattern.structure: image cell (optional) | body cell with optional category paragraph before the heading (eyebrow), the article title as a heading (usually linked), optional summary text and an optional final button paragraph (pinned to the card bottom). A card without a heading uses its link as the title (country-grid)

usage: Default: unboxed article teasers (rounded image, category eyebrow, linked title) in a 3-column grid. country-grid: small round flag icon above a centred country link, 5 columns. with-button / with-button-2: boxed cards with image, title, summary and a full-width 'Read more' button pinned to the bottom (with-button-2 tolerates cards without an image). image: image-led teaser with a wider image. green-light: centred boxed cards alternating light and dark surfaces, with a tag-style eyebrow. Section background comes from section metadata Style, not a block class.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for related-article, resource and blog listings. Use cards-feature for product/feature promos and cards-icon for icon-led feature lists.
